title: pp-node fleet
description: pp-node /metrics (docs/contracts/NODE_METRICS.md) via the OpenTelemetry Collector; host_name / deployment_environment labels come from the collector.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: Nodes whose /metrics reached the store in the last few minutes (pp_build_info present).

panels.title: Nodes down
panels.description: Nodes seen in the last 24 h whose /metrics no longer arrive: stopped, or their collector is.

targets.expr: count(max by (host_name, deployment_environment) (max_over_time(pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"}[1d])) unless max by (host_name, deployment_environment) (pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Directory heartbeat failing
panels.description: Nodes with the heartbeat on (opt-in, org seeds) whose last success is over 10 min old. A node with the heartbeat off is not counted; liveness is Nodes up / down.

panels.title: Not reachable
panels.description: Nodes whose reachability verdict is blocked or outbound only: others cannot dial them.

panels.title: Node versions
panels.description: How many nodes run each version, per environment.

panels.title: Machine CPU
panels.description: Whole machine (hostmetrics): the share of CPU time not idle.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node: its environment and version (pp_build_info), uptime, reachability verdict (pp_reachability_status) and the services it is serving (pp_node_capability). Sort or filter by any column.

targets.expr: label_replace((max by (host_name) (pp_process_uptime_seconds{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"})) * on (host_name) group_left (deployment_environment, version) max by (host_name, deployment_environment, version) (pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"}), "col", "uptime", "", "")

label_replace(((max by (host_name) (pp_reachability_status{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",status="unknown"} == 1) * 0 + 0) or (max by (host_name) (pp_reachability_status{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",status="checking"} == 1) * 0 + 1) or (max by (host_name) (pp_reachability_status{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",status="reachable"} == 1) * 0 + 2) or (max by (host_name) (pp_reachability_status{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",status="outbound_only"} == 1) * 0 + 3) or (max by (host_name) (pp_reachability_status{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",status="blocked"} == 1) * 0 + 4)) * on (host_name) group_left (deployment_environment, version) max by (host_name, deployment_environment, version) (pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"}), "col", "reach", "", "")

label_replace((max by (host_name) (pp_node_capability{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",service="circuit_relay"})) * on (host_name) group_left (deployment_environment, version) max by (host_name, deployment_environment, version) (pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"}), "col", "circuit_relay", "", "")

label_replace((max by (host_name) (pp_node_capability{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",service="media_relay"})) * on (host_name) group_left (deployment_environment, version) max by (host_name, deployment_environment, version) (pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"}), "col", "media_relay", "", "")

label_replace((max by (host_name) (pp_node_capability{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host",service="dht"})) * on (host_name) group_left (deployment_environment, version) max by (host_name, deployment_environment, version) (pp_build_info{deployment_environment=~"$env",host_name=~"$host"}), "col", "dht", "", "")

panels.title: pp-node memory (RSS)
panels.description: The pp-node process only. Normal is a few MiB to tens of MiB.

panels.title: pp-node CPU
panels.description: User + system CPU, fraction of one core.

panels.title: Machine memory used
panels.description: Whole machine (hostmetrics). 'used' excludes page cache; 'total' is all states summed = installed RAM.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: docker_stats for the pp-node container. Counts page cache, so it reads higher than RSS.

panels.title: Machine memory used (share)
panels.description: Whole machine (hostmetrics): used memory as a share of installed RAM.

panels.title: Container CPU (cores)
panels.description: docker_stats: CPU per container on the node, in cores.
